CHIEF COMPLAINT
Right knee pain from injury at trampoline park.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient is a male who sustained a right knee injury one week ago while at a trampoline park with his wife. This was his first time visiting a trampoline park. He heard a snap and experienced instant pain when he landed. He reports the pain is primarily on the lateral (outside) aspect of the knee. He has not tried any treatments other than elevation and Tylenol, which was ineffective. He has a limp and can bear weight but with difficulty. He was reluctant to seek medical care.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient states his blood sugars are a little bit better. He is checking blood sugars approximately 4-5 times per week. He reports his diet is "decent, could be better"—he is trying to watch his carbs and what he eats but is not counting calories or on a specific diet plan. He denies being on a keto diet. He states his exercise regimen is inconsistent and not done regularly. He has not been measuring salt intake.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Hypertension
Diabetes mellitus

MEDICATIONS
Lisinopril 20 mg daily
Metformin 500 mg daily

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient is married. He does not exercise regularly. This was his first visit to a trampoline park. He is reluctant to seek medical care.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital Signs: Blood pressure 180/80 mmHg (elevated)
General: Patient able to ambulate with a limp
Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm, no murmur appreciated
Pulmonary: Lungs clear bilaterally
Right Knee: Tenderness on lateral aspect with palpation, no tenderness on medial aspect, ecchymosis and edema on lateral aspect, no effusion, able to bend and straighten knee with pain, decent range of motion, able to bear weight with difficulty

RESULTS
Right knee X-ray: No evidence of fracture or bony abnormality.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Right knee pain—Lateral ligament strain
   - Start meloxicam 15 mg daily for pain and swelling
   - Refer to physical therapy for strengthening and injury prevention
   - Further imaging if pain persists

2. Hypertension
   - Continue lisinopril 20 mg daily
   - Order echocardiogram (concerned about inadequate blood pressure control)
   - Possible medication adjustment pending results

3. Diabetes mellitus
   - Order hemoglobin A1C
   - Order lipid panel
   - Possible medication adjustments pending results
